fixed_paragraph: When someone asks for my help, I often decline if it doesn't benefit me. When a friend wants to borrow something, I usually say no because I value my possessions. When a colleague suggests a change, I often argue my point instead of agreeing. When someone shares their opinion, I tend to challenge it if I disagree. When a group decision is being made, I push for my own ideas rather than compromise. When someone tries to persuade me, I stand firm in my beliefs. When a stranger asks for a favor, I typically refuse unless there's something in it for me. When a discussion gets heated, I don't back down easily. When someone criticizes me, I defend myself rather than accept their viewpoint.
